test_numpy_dtypes_pytest: run the pytest test suite for pybind11 numpy dtype bindings and struct array support
test_recarray_creation: test creating and validating numpy recarrays with simple packed and nested struct dtypes via pybind11
test_format_descriptors: test pybind11 numpy format descriptor strings for struct types including padding and alignment
test_scalar_conversion: test converting numpy void scalars and recarray elements to and from pybind11 C++ struct classes
test_vectorize: test vectorized pybind11 function calls over numpy recarray inputs and verify element-wise results
